info.title: FalloutAssist API
info.description: FalloutAssist workaround and management APIs. Under Configurations → FalloutAssist API, name and generate a key, then copy it once. In Swagger Authorize, enter the key alone. Service requests send Authorization: Bearer <key>. Browser dashboard access remains open in this deployment; browser mutations require a session CSRF token. The service key authorizes management operations as well as agent jobs. Current deployment TLS trust is configured separately in each API client.

retrieval_top_k.description: Usable tickets requested from each retrieval source. Either can return fewer; MCP discovery is capped at 30 candidates.

rerank_pool_k.description: Bounded deduplicated comparison pool; must not exceed retrieval_top_k.

jira_review_top_k.description: Final drafting sources; must not exceed rerank_pool_k.

routing_min_sources.description: Applicable, actionable, traceable sources needed to stop investigation fallback.

routing_min_llm_relevance.description: Real AI relevance threshold used with applicability and evidence checks, not a success probability.

rovo_mcp_always_search.description: Default true: local top K plus MCP top K, then one combined rerank. False restores local-first MCP fallback.

publish_enabled.description: Allows Jira posting during scans only when dry_run is false and evidence/review checks pass.

dry_run.description: True saves scan previews without posting. Manual previews and knowledge jobs never post.

ingest_interval_minutes.description: History refresh interval in minutes. Zero disables automatic ingestion.

scan_interval_minutes.description: New-ticket scan interval in minutes. Zero disables automatic scans.

FalloutAssistSettings.description: All runtime settings. PUT accepts a partial object. Weights must sum to 1 and drafting/pool K must fit retrieval K.

JIRA_API_TOKEN.description: Secret: omit to preserve; empty string clears it.

ROVO_API_TOKEN.description: Secret: omit to preserve; empty string clears it.

SALESFORCE_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Secret: omit to preserve; empty string clears it.

AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Secret: omit to preserve; empty string clears it.

FEEDBACK_SECRET.description: Secret: omit to preserve; empty string clears it.

LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret: omit to preserve; empty string clears it.

KNOWLEDGE_ROUTER_API_KEY.description: Legacy single FalloutAssist key; prefer POST /api/falloutassist-api-keys to create named keys.

SEMANTIC_CACHE_REDIS_URL.description: Secret: omit to preserve; empty string clears it.

secrets.description: Whether each secret is configured. Secret values are never returned.

source_keys.description: Optional historical keys for the separate Rovo proposal.

status_url.description: Poll this relative URL with the same Bearer key.

review_required.description: If true, the consuming service must obtain human review before acting.

comment_body.description: Preview text only; no Jira comment was posted.

full.description: False performs incremental refresh; true rebuilds vectors. Both use the saved authoritative history JQL.

last_completed_run.description: Latest successful run. Older runs may lack new/updated/removed counts; missing does not mean zero.

key.description: Plaintext key returned once at creation.

FalloutAssistApiKey.description: FalloutAssist API key. Enter only the generated key, without the Bearer prefix.
